title: I Will Recount Your Wonderful Deeds

questions.question: I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:1 (ESV): "I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart;"

questions.question: I will be glad and exult in you; I will sing praise to your name, O what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:2 (ESV): "I will sing praise to your name, O Most High."

questions.question: But the Lord sits enthroned forever; he has established his throne for what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:7 (ESV): "...he has established his throne for justice,"

questions.question: The Lord is a stronghold for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:9 (ESV): "The Lord is a stronghold for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble."

questions.question: And those who know your name put their trust in you, for you, O Lord, have not forsaken those who what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:10 (ESV): "...for you, O Lord, have not forsaken those who seek you."

questions.question: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish before your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:3 (ESV): "...they stumble and perish before your presence."

questions.question: You have rebuked the nations; you have made the wicked perish; you have blotted out their name when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:5 (ESV): "...you have blotted out their name forever and ever."

questions.question: He judges the world with righteousness; he judges the peoples with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:8 (ESV): "and he judges the world with righteousness; he judges the peoples with uprightness."

questions.question: Have mercy on me, O Lord! See my affliction from those who what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:13 (ESV): "See my affliction from those who hate me,"

questions.question: The nations have sunk in the pit that they made; in the net that they hid, their own foot has been what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:15 (ESV): "...in the net that they hid, their own foot has been caught."

questions.question: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, and the hope of the poor shall not perish when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:18 (ESV): "...and the hope of the poor shall not perish forever."

questions.question: Put them in fear, O Lord! Let the nations know that they are but what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:20 (ESV): "Let the nations know that they are but men!"

questions.question: The wicked shall return to Sheol, all the nations that forget whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:17 (ESV): "The wicked shall return to Sheol, all the nations that forget God."

questions.question: Higgaion. Selah. implies what?
questions.explanation: Higgaion combined with Selah suggests a meditative pause in the music (Psalm 9:16).

questions.question: For he who specifices blood remembers them; he does not forget the cry of the whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 9:12 (ESV): "For he who avenges blood is mindful of them; he does not forget the cry of the afflicted."

key_verse_text: I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart; I will recount all of your wonderful deeds.
